fixed_scope.output: Desktop relevant-name metadata; directly listed Sirius/Remediation directory names and matching metadata/manifest/tape/comparator names. Never open file contents or descend any other directory.
fixed_scope.reparse_policy: Check each fixed ancestor in order using its own WIN32_FIND_DATAW attributes; stop below any reparse or non-directory/access failure. Desktop Sirius/Remediation must be direct non-reparse directories and are rechecked before their one-level listing. Child reparse points are reported as metadata only, never descended.

interop: Existing x64 Windows PowerShell Desktop only. One in-memory Reflection.Emit type exposes exact FindFirstFileW/FindNextFileW/FindClose with SetLastError and PreserveSig. Fixed 592-byte WIN32_FIND_DATAW layout, UTF-16 buffers, INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE and error18 completion handled. No Add-Type, external compiler/child executable, filesystem provider path-normalization dependency, admin, mount, restore or privilege change.

bounds.synchronous_call_limit: Soft limits checked between calls; ROOT existing query.py/terminal adapters enforce outer lifetime/ownership. No new driver helper is supplied.

output_contract.bootstrap: query-bootstrap.json: sirius-july-snapshot-desktop-bootstrap-v1 with held own-process handle PID/start UTC
output_contract.exit0: All three Desktop walks and any selected direct Sirius/Remediation walks ended with complete enumeration, without bounds/gaps/close errors. Missing optional direct directories are not enumerated.
output_contract.exit2: Access-denied, missing/non-directory/reparse ancestor, partial native enumeration, unsupported API/runtime, cap/deadline or cleanup gap. Preserve per-target status/Win32 errors/partial records; do not turn these into no-snapshot or no-July conclusions.
output_contract.metadata_errors: FindFirst errors2/3 are reported path-not-found; error5 access-denied; only FindNext error18 completes enumeration. Wildcard error2 on a just-validated directory is recorded as empty, with the non-atomic caveat below.

ownership: Held own process handle and bootstrap precede API setup; each find handle closes in finally. Path allocations/native data buffer are freed. ROOT existing 60s driver and terminal remain mandatory; source packet itself does not authorize execution.
limits: Name and directory timestamps do not identify original July tapes, comparator/manifest contents or VSS creation time.
Readability is unknown until ROOT runs this distinct operation; observed names do not establish ACL access.

The walk is non-atomic. Ancestor reparse checks prevent intentional link traversal but cannot eliminate concurrent namespace replacement/TOCTOU; snapshot deletion/rebinding or path changes must not be silently treated as original historical identity.
No recursive Users/drive/image search, file content read, restore, mounting, source/build mutation, hydration request, admin/UAC, network or new toolchain.

The preceding completed NT-name route is unchanged. Only this query source/contracts are frozen; ROOT owns later adapter copying/admission/execution and must preserve actual results before further scope.
